patch_description:
The second program achieved the best combined score (0.56) with 120 parameters using shared RZ layers and a mix of CRZ and CZ gates. The current program has degraded to 72 parameters with only CZ gates, losing expressivity.

This edit implements the recommendation to split the shared RZ layer into two groups:
- "rz_pre_a" on qubits 0-4 (lower half)
- "rz_pre_b" on qubits 5-8 (upper half)

This provides more phase flexibility while maintaining parameter efficiency. I also restore parametrized CRZ gates on key pairs to improve entanglement expressivity, and use a simpler RY structure to keep total parameters around 120.

The asymmetry in RZ parameters allows the circuit to learn different phase corrections for different regions of the qubit space, which should improve both accuracy and generalization.
